acceptanceCriteria.criterion: Production deployment requires explicit canonical human approval.
Mirror and FREETREE cannot self-authorize canonical production changes.
Unknown capability or safety state is not treated as permission.
Credentials and secrets are not committed to source.
Material automated changes remain attributable and auditable.
Autonomous cleanup may delete only redundant branches with no unique commits and no open PR.
AI-generated assessments and optimizations do not become certification by themselves.
User-facing behavior preserves human control, reversibility, and truthful state representation.
BOTSQUAD AI agents cannot approve, merge, deploy production, weaken governance, or make autonomous commercial commitments.
ENVIRONMENT cannot transfer production authority, weaken Boundaries, disclose secrets, or automatically synchronize FREETREE.
